title: 2026 UK CBAM registration-threshold exclusion QA controls

sources.title: Imported Carbon Border Adjustment (CBAM) goods that may not contribute towards the registration threshold
Check if you’ll need to register for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)

facts.source_fact: CBAM goods imported for private use are exempt and do not contribute to the registration threshold.
facts.expected_handling: Exclude genuine private-use imports from threshold totals.

facts.source_fact: CBAM goods imported for commercial use may be liable and may contribute to the registration threshold.
facts.expected_handling: Do not apply the private-use exemption to profit-making or service use.

facts.source_fact: Imported CBAM goods of UK origin are exempt from CBAM and do not contribute to the registration threshold.
Re-imported goods qualifying for returned goods relief can be excluded when the required same-state and timing conditions are met.
facts.expected_handling: Require relief evidence before excluding value.

facts.source_fact: Returned goods relief guidance describes re-import within 3 years and in the same state as exported.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve both time and condition tests.

facts.source_fact: Goods under temporary admission with full relief from customs duties do not count towards the threshold while that treatment applies.
If those goods are discharged into free circulation and customs duties are due, their value contributes to the threshold.
Temporary-admission imports with only partial relief or no relief from customs duties count towards the registration threshold.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat partial relief as full exclusion.

facts.source_fact: Goods under a special customs procedure are generally outside CBAM until released into free circulation with customs duties due.
facts.expected_handling: Bind threshold treatment to procedure exit.

facts.source_fact: Inward and outward processing can cause all, part, or the value difference of CBAM goods to count towards the threshold depending on the resulting goods and release into free circulation.
facts.expected_handling: Use the procedure-specific value basis rather than gross import value blindly.

guard_patterns.handling: Track temporary and special procedure status.
Reassess when goods enter free circulation.
Apply the correct whole, partial or differential value basis.
Use the 16 July 2026 HMRC guidance state.
Do not infer site emissions from customs threshold treatment.
Flag unresolved origin, procedure, relief or value conflicts.
